timings.scope: CPU wall time, 32 monitored walk steps or one complete BFS. Each walk includes grid/shift construction and initial-state preparation. Classical uses the same builder, including coin validation. Quantum includes SDK simulation and detector projection. No frame capture, plots, export or network. Exact probabilities, no sampled shots. Walks detect the exit; BFS returns a shortest route. No QPU execution.
